musicians.flag: most famous musicians fall in the sub-themes; this list covers classical performers, opera singers, blues, reggae, hip hop, folk, electronic and world musicians outside them

composers.flag: covers classical-era, medieval, renaissance, 20th-century and musical-theater composers; baroque, romantic, opera and film composers are in sub-themes

dance.flag: the sub-themes cover almost everything; these are general dance words (people, events, places, rhythm) that fit none of them

folk dances.flag: the regional sub-themes cover nearly all folk dances; these are generic folk-dance types and dances from regions without a sub-theme (Melanesia, Australia, Caribbean)

art.flag: sub-themes cover most art vocabulary; this list holds art forms outside them (printmaking, crafts, street and digital art) and roles in the art world

painters.flag: covers baroque, rococo, neoclassical, romantic, realist, Pre-Raphaelite, British, American and Japanese painters and the Post-Impressionists; Renaissance, Impressionist, modern, Dutch, Spanish and Latin American painters are in sub-themes
